dataset.coordinates_per_view: 16 Tx x 16 Rx x 600 frequency samples

split.test_policy: reserved test is not opened or materialized by preparation, fit, or this readout; evaluate it only in a separately reviewed frozen-checkpoint readout

target.normalization: unclipped linear peak fitted on train targets only

model.capacity_rationale: 2048 is 32 times the verified 64-Gaussian smoke capacity and provides two initial rows per 32x32 output bin; it is a conservative full-scene candidate, not a measured convergence choice

optimization.budget_rationale: The trainer samples one train view per update from the sealed 3200-view permutation. The authorized production target is exactly 150 complete passes, so 150 x 3200 = 480000 optimizer updates. The existing SH degree activates every 600 updates and is preserved across all 150 passes; validation remains every 600 updates, yielding 800 validation checkpoints including the terminal step. This is a production-length candidate, not the earlier one-pass 3200-update review candidate

objective.observable_policy: native power and occupancy only; no coherent or amplitude claim

strategy.densification: disabled; the corrected trainer has no reviewed densification implementation
strategy.prune_policy: strict opacity comparison with retain-one guard and checkpointable topology restore

renderer.rationale: retain the renderer controls exercised by the smoke until a larger-capacity allocation measures a safe alternative

resources.capacity_basis: smoke measured 1.35 GiB process RSS and 32.3 MiB Torch allocation at 64 Gaussians; 2048 rows and the full cache remain unmeasured and must pass phase-level accounting

lifecycle.resume_policy: resume only an exact durable cache/checkpoint lifecycle; terminal preparation, fit, or readout failures remain terminal evidence
